intro:
Fangled Group is a strategy-first growth consultancy. 

We are a business growth consultancy that empowers companies to achieve greater success through in-depth value focused market research and segmented customer analysis. 

We guide you towards a deep understanding of your business and the unique value proposition that resonates with your ideal customer bases.

Even those who don’t do business with you today can also be part of your hoard of powerful brand advocates who love what you do, adore what you provide, and shout your praises from the hilltop.

Attract the Perfect Customer:

Our process leverages in-depth research to identify your ideal customer segments. We then research the true value your offerings bring to them, ensuring your message resonates.

We go beyond simply identifying your ideal customer segments. We delve into what truly matters to them: their needs, challenges, current situation (where they are in their journey), and preferred communication channels (how they like to be addressed). This clarity allows us to craft a compelling value proposition that speaks directly to their “what’s in it for me?” question.

Armed with this in-depth understanding, we craft a data-driven go-to-market strategy designed to attract the right customers and propel your growth.

Beyond Growth:

Fangled Group goes beyond just growth. We offer services to support businesses navigating exit planning, and we assist private equity firms and M&A professionals by conducting in-depth research on target companies and markets. Our research helps identify potential red flags and market opportunities, providing the clarity needed for informed decisions.

statement.text:
Most marketing starts with what a company wants to say. You are not your market.

Ours starts with what the market needs to hear. That’s how a first touch becomes a buyer, and a buyer becomes an advocate.
